# SurrealEngine — adapted, not vendored

No SurrealEngine file is copied here. `src/ubake/FireStill.cpp` adapts the
fire simulation from SurrealEngine's `UFireTexture::UpdateFrame`, and the zlib
licence it is under asks that its notice stay with an altered version. That
notice is [LICENSE](LICENSE); `src/ubake/FireStill.h` says what was altered —
`ROADMAP UTA-0176`.

## Upstream

- **Repository:** <https://github.com/dpjudas/SurrealEngine>
- **File:** `SurrealEngine/Packages/Engine/Resources/Textures/UFireTexture.cpp`
- **Retrieved:** 2026-09-17, from the `master` branch
